errorCodes.meaning: No member with the supplied did exists.
The presentation's challenge is unknown or expired. Open a new personhood/challenge.

The Verifiable Presentation failed verification, its holder did not match did, or it did not satisfy the community's active personhood policy — including where the policy rests on a Verifiable Witness Credential that counts for nothing because it has no paired outcome evidence.

EvidenceDocument.description: A whole Trust Task document — `id`, `type`, `payload` and every other member, `proof` included — carried exactly as it was sent or received, never re-serialised: a task digest and a proof are taken over its members, and a re-serialised copy reproduces neither reliably. Typed as an open object so every member survives; the checks that give it meaning belong to the task that reads it.
EvidenceDocument.title: EvidenceDocument

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

OutcomeEvidence.description: One witnessing session's outcome evidence. `session` is the initiating witness/session document; `outcome` is the terminal witness/session/submit #response that the initiating document's own specification declares as its outcome evidence, under the witness's proof, delivering the VWC and its vwcDigestMultibase. A consumer pairs them with a presented VWC by SPEC §4.9.4's four checks and the witnessing checks of witness/session/submit (This response is the outcome evidence).

outcome.description: The witness/session/submit #response that closed the session, under the witness's proof. It carries the VWC and its vwcDigestMultibase.

session.description: The witness/session document that opened the session. The VWC's taskContext is its id and its taskDigestMultibase is computed over it (SPEC §4.9.3).

OutcomeEvidence.title: OutcomeEvidence

personhood.description: Always true on success — the flag flipped or stayed asserted.

roleVac.description: Re-issued role credential (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues.

vmc.description: Re-issued membership credential carrying the asserted personhood (opaque here).

did.description: The member asserting personhood; MUST equal the presentation's holder.

outcomeEvidence.description: OPTIONAL. The outcome evidence of the witnessing sessions that the Verifiable Witness Credentials in presentation cite: one entry per VWC the member wants counted, each the witness/session document the VWC's taskContext names and the witness/session/submit #response that delivered it, exactly as stored, never re-serialised. A VWC with no paired entry counts for nothing; an entry pairing with no VWC in presentation is ignored.

presentation.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation (opaque here). Its holder MUST match did, its proof.challenge MUST be the paired challengeId, and it MUST carry at least one credential satisfying the community's active personhood policy. A Verifiable Witness Credential in it counts only with paired outcomeEvidence.
